name: Kittenswap Finance
description: ve(3,3) concentrated-liquidity DEX built on Algebra Integral, live on HyperEVM (full stack: swaps, LP NFTs, farming, KITTEN/veKITTEN voting) and Robinhood Chain (swaps and LP only). Agents can quote and swap through the SwapRouter/QuoterV2, open and manage LP positions via the NonfungiblePositionManager, farm positions, and lock KITTEN for veKITTEN.

keyFunctions.description: Single-pool exact-input swap. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, deployer, recipient, deadline, amountIn, amountOutMinimum, limitSqrtPrice). deployer = 0x000...0 for standard pools (non-zero only for custom-deployer pools); limitSqrtPrice = 0 for no limit. Approve tokenIn to the router first. Payable: to swap native gas token, send it as msg.value with tokenIn = WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555. Returns amountOut.

Multi-hop exact-input swap. Tuple: (path, recipient, deadline, amountIn, amountOutMinimum). Algebra Integral path encoding: tokenIn(20 bytes) + deployer(20 bytes) + token(20 bytes) [+ deployer + token ...]; no fee field. Returns amountOut.

Single-pool exact-output swap. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, deployer, recipient, deadline, amountOut, amountInMaximum, limitSqrtPrice). Returns amountIn. When paying with native token, add refundNativeToken() in a multicall.
Multi-hop exact-output swap: (path in REVERSE order, recipient, deadline, amountOut, amountInMaximum). Returns amountIn.
Same tuple as exactInputSingle, for fee-on-transfer tokens.
Batch router calls, e.g. swap to the router (recipient = router address) then unwrapWNativeToken to receive the native token.
Unwrap the router's WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555 balance to native and send to recipient. Args (amountMinimum, recipient). Use inside multicall.
Return any leftover native token held by the router to msg.sender (use after exact-output swaps paid in native).
Wrapped native token address (WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555).

Quote (call with eth_call, it is not a view function). Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, deployer, amountIn, limitSqrtPrice). Returns (amountOut, amountIn, sqrtPriceX96After, initializedTicksCrossed, gasEstimate, fee).
Multi-hop quote via eth_call: (path, amountIn). Returns (amountOutList[], amountInList[], sqrtPriceX96AfterList[], initializedTicksCrossedList[], gasEstimate, feeList[]).
Exact-output quote via eth_call. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, deployer, amount, limitSqrtPrice).
Multi-hop exact-output quote via eth_call; path in reverse order.

Open a concentrated-liquidity position NFT. Tuple: (token0, token1, deployer, tickLower, tickUpper, amount0Desired, amount1Desired, amount0Min, amount1Min, recipient, deadline). token0 < token1 by address; ticks must be multiples of the pool tickSpacing. Approve both tokens first. Returns (tokenId, liquidity, amount0, amount1).
Add to a position: (tokenId, amount0Desired, amount1Desired, amount0Min, amount1Min, deadline). Returns (liquidity, amount0, amount1).
Remove liquidity: (tokenId, liquidity, amount0Min, amount1Min, deadline). Tokens are only credited to the position; call collect() to receive them.
Withdraw owed tokens and fees: (tokenId, recipient, amount0Max, amount1Max); use 2^128-1 for all. Returns (amount0, amount1).
Burn an empty position NFT (liquidity and owed tokens must be 0).
Position data: (nonce, operator, token0, token1, deployer, tickLower, tickUpper, liquidity, feeGrowthInside0LastX128, feeGrowthInside1LastX128, tokensOwed0, tokensOwed1).
Create and initialize a pool: (token0, token1, deployer, sqrtPriceX96, data). Returns pool address.
Batch calls (e.g. decreaseLiquidity + collect, or mint with native token + refundNativeToken).
Number of position NFTs owned.
Enumerate an owner's position tokenIds.
Approve a position for farming: (tokenId, approve, farmingAddress = FarmingCenter). Required before FarmingCenter.enterFarming.
Standard pool address for a token pair (either order); zero address if none. One pool per pair (dynamic fee).
Pool created by a custom deployer: (customDeployer, tokenA, tokenB).
Deterministic standard pool address for (token0, token1).
AlgebraPoolDeployer address.

Stake a position NFT in an eternal-farming incentive. Args: IncentiveKey (rewardToken, bonusRewardToken, pool, nonce) and tokenId. Call NonfungiblePositionManager.approveForFarming(tokenId, true, FarmingCenter) first.
Leave the incentive (IncentiveKey, tokenId).
Accrue rewards for a farmed position; returns (reward, bonusReward). Then claimReward to receive them.
Send accrued rewards: (rewardToken, to, amountRequested); 0 = all. Returns amount.
Active eternal incentiveId (bytes32) for a tokenId; zero if not farmed.
Pending (reward, bonusReward) for (IncentiveKey, tokenId).
Claimable reward balance for (owner, rewardToken).
KITTEN balance (18 decimals).
Approve KITTEN (e.g. to veKITTEN before create_lock, or to the router).
ERC-20 transfer.
Lock KITTEN for a veKITTEN NFT: (amount, lockDurationSeconds). Docs: min 1 week, max 2 years, weekly increments, linear decay. Approve KITTEN first. Locked KITTEN cannot be withdrawn until expiry.
Same as create_lock but mints the NFT to another address.
Add KITTEN to an existing lock: (tokenId, amount).
Extend a lock: (tokenId, newLockDurationSeconds).
Withdraw KITTEN from an expired lock (tokenId).
Merge lock (from, to).
Lock amount and end time for a tokenId.
Current voting power of a veKITTEN NFT.
Whether the NFT has active votes (may block withdraw/transfer until reset).
Enumerate an owner's veKITTEN tokenIds.

Vote emissions with a veKITTEN NFT: (tokenId, addresses[], weights[]). Signature confirmed in bytecode; whether the address list is pools or gauges is not confirmed from source, so prefer the app (app.kittenswap.finance/vote).
Minimum delay (seconds) for queued admin operations; 60 at time of research.

actions.name: quote
actions.how: eth_call QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle((tokenIn, tokenOut, 0x0 deployer, amountIn, 0)) and read amountOut.

actions.name: swap
actions.how: tokenIn.approve(SwapRouter, amountIn); SwapRouter.exactInputSingle((tokenIn, tokenOut, 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, recipient, deadline, amountIn, minOut, 0)). Set minOut from the quote minus slippage.

actions.name: swap-native
actions.how: exactInputSingle with tokenIn = WNativeToken() and msg.value = amountIn. To receive native: multicall([exactInputSingle(... recipient = router ...), unwrapWNativeToken(minOut, me)]).

actions.name: add-liquidity
actions.how: Find the pool with AlgebraFactory.poolByPair(a,b); approve both tokens to NonfungiblePositionManager; NPM.mint((token0, token1, 0x0, tickLower, tickUpper, amt0, amt1, min0, min1, me, deadline)).

actions.name: remove-liquidity
actions.how: NPM.multicall([decreaseLiquidity((tokenId, liquidity, min0, min1, deadline)), collect((tokenId, me, 2^128-1, 2^128-1))]).

actions.name: farm
actions.how: NPM.approveForFarming(tokenId, true, FarmingCenter); FarmingCenter.enterFarming(incentiveKey, tokenId); later collectRewards + claimReward. Incentive keys are easiest to get from the app.

actions.name: lock
actions.how: KITTEN.approve(veKITTEN, amt); veKITTEN.create_lock(amt, durationSeconds) with 1 week <= duration <= 2 years; vote in the app.

risks: Concentrated liquidity: positions out of range earn no fees and suffer impermanent loss; the pool fee is dynamic (Algebra plugin), not a fixed tier.

Upgradeable contracts: KITTEN, veKITTEN, Voter, RebaseReward and Minter are EIP-1967 proxies. Docs say proxy ownership moves to the TimelockController and the delay will rise from 1 minute to 24 hours; at research time getMinDelay() on the timelock still returned 60 seconds.
veKITTEN locks are illiquid until expiry (up to 2 years); voting power decays linearly.
Robinhood Chain has swaps and LP only; farming contracts exist there but incentives are not enabled, and veKITTEN/voting is HyperEVM-only. Positions and balances do not bridge between chains.

Older contracts (Phase 1 V2-style PairFactory/Router, Phase 2 CLFactory/NFP/SwapRouter, Phase 3 gauge factories) are deprecated and no longer supported; only use them via legacy.kittenswap.finance to exit old positions.

Audits: Kittenswap contracts reviewed by Pashov Audit Group (3 reports, 2025; the July 2025 one covers the current contracts); the Algebra Integral base is audited by Bailsec, ABDK, MixBytes, Paladin and Hexens per the Kittenswap docs.
notes: Addresses are from Kittenswap's official Deployed Contracts page (docs.kittenswap.finance) and the KITTEN token page; every one was checked with eth_getCode on HyperEVM (rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm, chainId 999) and Robinhood Chain (rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com, chainId 4663). The contracts are not on Sourcify and HyperEVMScan needs an API key, so function signatures were taken from the Algebra Integral periphery/farming interfaces (github.com/cryptoalgebra/Algebra, which Kittenswap docs name as its AMM) and each selector was confirmed present in the deployed bytecode. veKITTEN and Voter signatures were matched by selector only (Velodrome-v1 style snake_case VotingEscrow); argument meanings for these are inferred, and other Voter functions (claim bribes/fees, reset, poke) could not be identified, so they are left out - use the app for voting and claiming. Omitted but listed in the docs: HyperEVM Quoter (v1) 0x3aA96eDb755C44F3E50C5408a36abb52f28326Ba, NonfungibleTokenPositionDescriptor, TickLens, RebaseReward 0xDd002E8DF80ccB7A8964BFef6e15ee36D414fC36, Minter (dynamic emissions) 0xac36d3671f21A5056Cd1751E201574d702748C7A and the deprecated Minter; Robinhood AlgebraPoolDeployer 0x45362763166CfED6174d312Fa1449EA1FC37988a, Multicall3, AlgebraEternalFarming 0xc8A85FD6511bf875646B3632Aedd60d5752610BC and FarmingCenter 0xE416C0C29DBDb4Fa25870b835ad904c1E8478CDc (not enabled), USDG 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168 (6 decimals, third-party stablecoin). Robinhood pool CREATE2 init code hash: 0x62441ebe4e4315cf3d49d5957f94d66b253dbabe7006f34ad7f70947e60bf15c. HyperEVM wrapped native token is WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555 (read from SwapRouter.WNativeToken()). No official public API or GitHub was found (DefiLlama lists no GitHub).
